text:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 alert — GPU-serving queue growth detected in us-west-2 for rdx-large-v1. Queue depth ~12x baseline, sustained for ~4m. Autoscaler attempts failing with 403/scale_limit. Tickets opening for impacted customers.

Maya Patel: seeing it too, UI dashboards spiking. Latency up to 4-6s for many requests; 503s on some routes. Paging oncall.

Devon Chen: logs show repeated KV cache misses after last config rollout (~+6m). Prefix cache eviction rate jump: 95th percentile miss rate went from 1% -> 48%.

Sophie Nguyen: hmm that would blow up continuous batching — if KV cache misses cause more cold starts, we lose reuse and autoscaler sees increased queue. Any recent batch/caching rollouts?

Maya Patel: yes, rollout "batch-window-v2" merged ~8m ago. I pushed canary to 10% then 50% — might be correlated.

Devon Chen: stack trace snippet from router:
```
2026-03-15T12:07:02Z WARN prefix_cache.go:213 miss prefix=\"ctx:rdx-large-v1:prompt-shard-42\"
2026-03-15T12:07:03Z ERROR autoscaler.go:451 failed to scale: attempts=3 limit=50 current=46 err=scale_quota_exceeded
```

Maya Patel: attaching perf chart (copy pasted): queue depth -> 1200 reqs, healthy baseline 95. Token throughput flat, CPU pool unchanged.

infra-bot: Autoscaler snapshot: current_replicas=46 max_replicas=50 pending_scale_requests=8 average_latency=3.6s

Sophie Nguyen: immediate mitigations: 1) Pause batch-window-v2 rollout 2) Force prefix cache warmup/clear and reset TTLs 3) Temporarily increase autoscaler max_replicas to 80 4) Reroute non-prod/non-urgent traffic to CPU-shared pool

Liam O'Connor: oncall_rotation — stepping in. I'll take lead from here. Maya, can you pause the rollout? Devon, can you run the prefix cache inspection?

Maya Patel: pausing rollout now — flag: `rdx.rollout.batch-window-v2=false` applied to canary and global.

Devon Chen: running quick scan. Found a config diff: `continuous_batch.max_window` lowered from 120ms -> 40ms and `prefix_cache.eviction_threshold` bumped accidentally from 0.6 -> 0.2 in the same PR. That explains more frequent eviction and shorter batch windows -> higher per-request overhead.

Devon Chen: admin command to flush prefix cache on shard 42:
```bash
rdx-admin cache flush --region us-west-2 --shard 42 --key-prefix "ctx:rdx-large-v1"
```

Maya Patel: flushing top 10 hot shards now.

infra-bot: Command executed: shards flushed: [42, 43, 44] — estimated recoverable hit: ~30-40%

Liam O'Connor: raising autoscaler max now. Patch: `autoscaler.max_replicas=80` for us-west-2 (temporary). Applying.

infra-bot: Patch applied. New max_replicas=80.

Sophie Nguyen: also recommend disabling continuous batching temporarily to avoid micro-batches starving KV cache. Toggle: `continuous_batch.enabled=false`

Maya Patel: disabled continuous batching in us-west-2.

Devon Chen: watching metrics — prefix cache miss-rate dropping from 48% -> 22% after flush and TTL revert. Queue depth trending down: 1200 -> 300 in 5m.

PagerBot: Update: autoscaler actions succeeded, new replicas 62, queue drain in progress. No new scale errors after limit increase.

Sophie Nguyen: customer impact note — support reports ~15 customers saw transient 5xx for ~6m window. We've opened post-incident notifications.

Liam O'Connor: oncall handoff: I'm primary until this is in steady-state. Maya staying on to help with communications. Devon will run detailed root-cause sweeps. Sophie to coordinate customer comms.

Maya Patel: creating incident channel #incident-4234567890. Will post timeline.

Devon Chen: quick diff of the PR that introduced the change (author: infra-eng/rolling-batches):
```diff
- continuous_batch.max_window = 120ms
- prefix_cache.eviction_threshold = 0.6
+ continuous_batch.max_window = 40ms  # unintended low value
+ prefix_cache.eviction_threshold = 0.2
```

Devon Chen: looks like a bad default landed in the roll. Tagging the author and approving rollback.

Maya Patel: rolling back those two config keys to previous values across the fleet. Patch ID: rollback-4234567890-batchparams.

infra-bot: Rollback applied to prod us-west-2. Configs now: continuous_batch.max_window=120ms prefix_cache.eviction_threshold=0.6

Devon Chen: validating — miss-rate down to 6% now, tail latency improving. Queue now ~40 (near baseline).

PagerBot: Incident state: mitigated — queue drained to acceptable thresholds, autoscaler stable. Still tracking until next 30m.

Liam O'Connor: action items: 1) Postmortem assigned to Devon + Maya + Sophie 2) Add config validation gate for batching/cache PRs 3) Add autoscaler soft-limit alerts before hard fail 4) Run chaos test for cache-eviction scenarios

Sophie Nguyen: customer comms draft: "We experienced elevated error rates and latency due to a configuration rollout affecting batching and prefix cache settings. We mitigated by pausing the rollout, flushing caches, and rolling back the change. We're following up with a postmortem and action items."

Maya Patel: confirming support tickets opened for affected customers with link: https://support.redwood.ai/cases/INC-98765

Liam O'Connor: leaving a final note: thanks team, good rapid coordination. Keeping channel open for 30m for monitoring, then we'll archive and start postmortem doc. :white_check_mark:

PagerBot: Auto-reminder: assign postmortem within 48h and include timeline + diff + playbook updates.

Devon Chen: will start the timeline and metrics capture now.

Maya Patel: handing off to Liam (primary). Signing off soon but will stay reachable.

Liam O'Connor: acknowledgement. Oncall until 13:30 UTC.

PagerBot: Thread closed: mitigation successful — follow-up actions scheduled.
